title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of Grand Lotto P271M, Megalotto P110M prizes on Oct. 14 draws
summary: There were no winners of the P271 million Grand Lotto 6/55 and P110 million Megalotto 6/45 jackpot draws on October 14, 2026 a, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Wednesday.

blocks.text: There were no winners of the P271 million Grand Lotto 6/55 and P110 million Megalotto 6/45 jackpot draws on October 14, 2026 a, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Wednesday.
No bettor picked the winning combination of 10-54-08-35-34-38 for the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of P271,057,948.06.
It was also better luck next time for those who played Megalotto 6/45 and its P110,527,091.63 jackpot after no one picked the right numbers of 16-44-08-43-24-39.
